design_philosophy: Premium EdTech Minimalism. 'Apple Liquid Glass' aesthetics intersecting with 'Organic & Earthy' structural clarity. Avoid standard corporate SaaS aesthetics. Every screen must feel like a high-end personal growth tool with fluid transitions, generous breathing room, and crystal-clear hierarchy.

theme.background_strategy: Off-white base (slate-50) with large, blurred, absolute-positioned decorative orbs (blue-400/20, teal-300/20) behind glassmorphic surfaces to create depth.

headings.rules: Never use Inter/Roboto. Headings must feel editorial and modern.

body.rules: Highly legible, slightly geometric. Use text-slate-600 for optimal reading contrast.

surfaces_and_glassmorphism.premium_glass_card: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/60 border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(30,58,138,0.05)] rounded-3xl
surfaces_and_glassmorphism.rules: Never place long body text directly on pure glass without a sufficient opaque tint. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-blue-500 text-white font-medium px-8 py-4 shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30 transition-transform active:scale-95 hover:-translate-y-1
buttons.secondary_glass: rounded-full backdrop-blur-md bg-white/50 border border-blue-100 text-blue-900 font-medium px-8 py-4 transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.floating_action: absolute bottom-24 right-6 w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xl shadow-blue-600/40 flex items-center justify-center active:scale-90 transition-all

bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 w-full pb-safe pt-4 px-6 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/80 border-t border-white/50 flex justify-between items-center shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] rounded-t-3xl
bottom_nav.inactive_tab: text-slate-400 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 transition-colors hover:text-blue-400

progress_rings.fill: stroke-blue-500 stroke-[8px] fill-none stroke-linecap-round transition-all duration-1000

splash.elements: Animated logo (framer-motion scale & opacity), fade out to onboarding.

onboarding.layout: Full screen image/abstract art at top, white glassmorphic card sliding up from bottom containing text and 'Next' button.
onboarding.elements: Pagination dots (blue-600 for active, slate-200 for inactive).

home_dashboard.header: Welcome text (H2) + User Avatar + Streak Flame icon.
home_dashboard.daily_goal_card: Premium glass card spanning full width. Circular progress indicator, XP text, 'Continue Learning' primary button.
home_dashboard.challenge_bento: 2-column grid. Left: 'Speak 5 min' (tall card), Right: 'Learn 20 words' (square card).

speak_practice_mocked.layout: Radar pulsing animation in center for 'Finding Match'. Mocked match found -> Transition to call UI.
speak_practice_mocked.call_ui: Dark glass theme for focus. User and Partner avatars with soundwave animations. 'End Call' pill button in red.

lessons_hub.layout: Horizontal scroll carousels for categories (Business, Travel, IELTS). Cards use image backgrounds with dark gradient overlays to ensure text readability.

profile_and_premium.layout: Header with avatar and level badge. Grid of achievements.
profile_and_premium.premium_card: Deep navy background (dark mode inside light app), gold accents, 'Tracing Beam' shimmering border effect for the Stripe subscription call-to-action.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Animate Presence with fade and slight Y-axis slide (y: 20 -> 0).
motion_and_interactions.tap_feedback: All interactive elements MUST have whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} or active:scale-95.

image_urls.usage: User profiles, Real People matches, Host avatars in Live Groups.
Backgrounds for specific English lesson cards. Apply bg-black/40 overlay.
Premium 3D abstract backgrounds for Grammar, Vocab, and IELTS lessons.
Background for Public Speaking course or Live Groups header.
Certificate/Trophy placeholder in the Profile screen.

assets.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). They feel more premium than standard free icons.
assets.toast: Use sonner for non-intrusive notifications (e.g., 'Word Saved!', 'Friend Request Sent').

testing.requirements: All interactive buttons, inputs, and major containers MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-lesson-button').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic flat designs. Apply layered depth using background orbs and glassmorphism.
NEVER use generic system fonts (Inter, Roboto, Open Sans). Stick strictly to Outfit and Manrope.
NO placeholder screens. Build out the actual layout for every requested tab.
Ensure the bottom navigation doesn't hide content (add appropriate pb to main container).
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays where content scrolls underneath.
Ensure contrast ratios are met. Text on glass needs to be dark slate or have a solid container behind it.
All image backgrounds must use gradient overlays to ensure white text is readable.
MOCK the 'Speak with Real People' flow with a beautiful finding-match animation and a dummy call screen.
